description: Données Ouvertes sur les Châteaux d'Eau - Forages - TdE is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Les forages réalisés par TdE sont des installations essentielles pour l'approvisionnement en eau potable au Togo. Ces forages sont utilisés pour alimenter les châteaux d'eau, principalement dans les régions rurales et périurbaines où l'accès à l'eau de surface est limité. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Its tags are chateau, eau, forages. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
